exposure_audit.method: normalised containment (a new text contained in any earlier manifest/response/fixture/test string or local SLM train/val example counts as exposed)
exposure_audit.witness: the same check flags 138/139 /12 texts as exposed; the one miss carries no geometry word (documented filter limit)
exposure_audit.corpus_not_committed: it embeds the local SLM training sets; regenerate with --training-dir %LOCALAPPDATA%/axo-slm/training

coverage_disclosure: The agent authored this set after reading the /12 residual taxonomy (G1-G5, §17, §19, I05). Phrase families of those residuals (two lateral faces perpendicular to the base, three mutually perpendicular edges, derived point O, rhombus with angle) appear with new labels and wording, mixed into a balanced set. A pass here is evidence of generalisation over NEW TEXTS, not over an independently sampled distribution.

harness.oracle: scene_oracle.py (independent exact validator, Fraction + Gram metric)

primary.SIMULATION_COMPLETION_RATE_in_scope: >= 0.85 over the 100 in-scope cases (completed = SERVED AND exact oracle MATHEMATICALLY_VALID AND numeric CORRECT when asked AND initial visual ok AND interaction ok)

slm_recovery.stratum: SLM_REQUIRED = in-scope cases whose deterministic-parser-only dry run on the EVALUATED candidate is not LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE (candidate_bind freeze); the baseline freeze stratum is reported alongside
slm_recovery.SLM_VERIFIED_SCENE_RATE: >= 0.30 AND >= 5 SLM-provenance completed scenes in SLM_REQUIRED (reported separately from the primary rate)
slm_recovery.provenance_rule: SLM_CONTRIBUTED only if route_d.extraction_mode starts with LOCAL_SLM and the response was generated live without cache or replay; deterministic parser rescues are DETERMINISTIC_ONLY progress, never SLM credit

safe_refusal: negatives = 1.0 refused (prompt injection may also serve exact uncorrupted geometry); includes HN13-HN15 (metric question on a shape fixed only up to similarity must stay refused)
visual: every completed scene: canvas ink >= 1%, initial camera fits all solid vertices and gold labels before reset/orbit, 0 console errors, no stale scene across problem changes
interaction: every registered orbit/zoom/reset/step/responsive viewport scenario passes; VI06 is bound to HD05 and passes only with a clarification toast, no canvas and no capability-gap wording

separate_strata.similarity: HS01-HS06 reported separately: served with route_d.scale_policy = UNIT_SIMILARITY_REPRESENTATIVE, no numeric answers, exact oracle valid, visual ok. Not part of the primary denominator.
separate_strata.underdetermined: HD01-HD06 reported separately: never served; clarification questions counted

decision_rule.LIVE_SIMULATION_ACCEPTED: primary threshold met AND every safety zero AND safe_refusal = 1.0 AND visual AND interaction
decision_rule.SLM_VERIFIED_SCENE_RATE: reported; failing it blocks LOCAL_MODEL1_REPLACEMENT_VERIFIED, not LIVE_SIMULATION_ACCEPTED
decision_rule.no_change_after_results: criteria, manifest, oracle and harness are frozen by ACCEPTANCE_FREEZE.json before any Model 1 or geometry change; none may change after the live run
decision_rule.exposure: the live run exposes this set: after it, the set is regression only. Any re-run after fixes is labelled POST_EXPOSURE and never reported as blind

performance_scope: Windows dev host only; deterministic / SLM / cold / warm latencies and memory reported, no cross-hardware claim
